info.name: Who is the Owner of the Mysterious Note?

descriptions.inProgress: While talking to Mu Young, you were suddenly transported to a foreign place and a Jr. Balrog appeared right in front of your eyes. Let's defeat the Jr. Balrog.
descriptions.completed: While talking to Mu Young, you were suddenly transported to a foreign place and a Jr. Balrog appeared right in front of your eyes. As soon as you defeated the Jr. Balrog, Tristan's Spirit appeared. You were able to hear the story of his past life.
